scores.tell: Matte painted metal truss and housing with soft gloss on lens; very close. Slightly uniform satin across the housing.
Moon dome: speckled rock noise on the ground and craters are painterly. Dome is plain smooth plastic and the glass has stepped facets. Texture is more rendered than the real cards.
None. Smooth enamel rim and matte clock face, with a gentle single highlight like the real cards.
Rope twist has fine, quiet ridges with matte yarn and small glossy highlights, matching the towel and saddle detail.
Fruit is highly glossy with many water droplets. Glass plate is photoreal and the wood grain is fine, so it reads more realistic than the real cards.
Water caustics and ripple texture are busy and painterly. Wood grain on the pier is fine, but the sand and sea are noisy compared with the smooth real cards.
Glossy green shell with strong highlights. Floor reflections are slightly lacquered and plasticky, but the matte seat and base balance it.
Wood shelf and brick wall are cartoon-glossy. Bear fur is smooth with no fiber, and everything shares one equal lacquered sheen.
Soft matte marble with a clean crack and a glossy sign. Near the references. The stone is slightly waxy and smooth throughout.
Pump is uniformly glossy painted plastic with one sheen. Cracked slab and desert scrub are fine but slightly noisy, and the ground is more painterly than the real cards.
